title: Boundary compatibility of explicit horseshoe resolution comparisons
statement: Let $v:A\to B$ be additive and left exact, $A,B$ abelian with derived categories and $A$ having enough injectives. Let $S$ be short exact and $I_A,I_B,I_C$ arbitrary compatible injective resolutions with maps alpha,beta, beta alpha=0, augmentation squares and short exact rows. Assume their termwise image H and extension EH are short exact. Let T=Rv(S[0]) and U=triangleOfSES(EH). For the explicit comparisons c_I of [lem-sc-p1-injective-resolution-derived-comparison], one has T.mor3;c_IA[1]=c_IC;U.mor3. This asserts only compatibility with the boundary, with no endpoint homology assertion.

source.place: Tags 014Q, 05TE and 015B: item proof Steps 1-4, fixed resolution triangle comparison before homology naturality; Tag 0159 (exactness of RF), Section 13.10 (termwise additive functors preserve split triangles)

proof.text: For any fixed injective resolution, use the lift of the identity from the chosen resolution. The augmentation squares identify the fixed augmentation iso with the chosen augmentation iso followed by the localized lift. Unit naturality identifies the chosen inverse unit followed by the localized image lift with the derived lift followed by the fixed inverse unit. Quotient-factorization naturality and mapExtendIso naturality prove that the displayed explicit comparison equals the fixed augmentation under Rv followed by boundedBelowInjectiveComparison and Q(mapExtendIso). This calculation is the proved private helper comparison_eq_unit.

Extend the compatible resolution SES by zero; exactness in nonnegative degrees is transported by extendXIso and in negative degrees all objects are zero. The extended augmentation maps give a morphism from the degree-zero SES to this extended SES. Apply Mathlib triangleOfSESδ_naturality to this morphism and transport through the quotient factorization and the full inclusion D⁺→D. This directly proves augmentation_boundary, without a vanishing-Hom or triangle-uniqueness argument.

Apply Rv to augmentation_boundary and commute its shift isomorphism past the augmentation comparison. Apply rightDerived_injectiveComplex_boundary to the extended resolution SES. The natural mapExtendIso components form an isomorphism of SESs from v(EI) to E(vI); apply canonical SES boundary naturality to this isomorphism. Compose the two boundary squares and replace the endpoint comparisons by comparison_eq_unit. These rewrites prove the original equation with its unchanged explicit comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem horseshoe_comparison_boundary
    {A : Type u₁} {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A]
    [EnoughInjectives A] [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} B]
    (v : A ⥤ B) [v.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits v]
    (S : ShortComplex A) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂)
    (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃)
    (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex)
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
    (_hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ A).map S.f ≫ IB.ι)
    (_hιB : IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ A).map S.g ≫ IC.ι)
    (_hH : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval A (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact)
    (hvH : ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (v.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ))).ShortExact)
    (hExt : (((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (v.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ))).map
      (ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat.extendFunctor B)).ShortExact) :
    let T := (v.rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).mapTriangle.obj
      hS.singleTrianglePlus
    let U := DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES hExt
    (T.mor₃ ≫ (injectiveResolutionDerivedComparison v IA)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
      injectiveResolutionDerivedComparison v IC ≫ U.mor₃)
